example.title: Veterans' Glass City Skyway (I-280 over the Maumee River)

brief: SR 14 over the Maumee River: the real Maumee's own contemporary crossing. A single-pylon cable-stayed bridge: one 122 m concrete pylon on the centreline whose top storeys are glass (lit at night), stays in a single plane to the median of a precast segmental box deck, two 186.5 m main spans, 2.7 km overall with segmental approaches, 36.6 m clearance. Here: two 170 m spans each side of the pylon on the river's centreline, segmental approaches over the basin. Lit glass crown in blue-white. Foundations: drilled shafts 30 m below the modelled bed under the pylon, 25 m under the rest.
